test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select 'no improvement required'.**

Turn left outside the library door and walk down the corridor __then you came to__ the main staircase.
solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. 'until you come to.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in Part (then you came to) of the sentence.
 
• The structure of the given sentence is incorrect.
 
• The nature of the sentence is instructional and it is in the present tense.
 
• In the wrong part the use of 'came' is in past tense we have to change it into 'come.'
 
• Here 'then' is an adverb. But we have to use a preposition before the pronoun 'you.'
 
• Here we have to replace **'then' **with the conjunction **'until.'**
 
• **'Until'** is used to indicate 'up to the event mentioned'. In this sentence, the subject was instructed to walk for some time till he reaches the main staircase.
 
• **Another Example:**
 
 
• Keep going **until I tell you to stop.**
 
 
 
• Therefore, the use of 'then you came to' in the sentence should be replaced with 'until you come to' to make it grammatically correct.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Correct sentence:__ *Turn left outside the library door and walk down the corridor __until you come to__ the main staircase.*
